summary: Iteration 5 verified the 'no dead ends' slice end-to-end: Decisions CRUD (owner 200, member 403, empty title 400, PATCH 404 on missing, existing /action still works), Telemetry computed from real financials/people/tasks (kpis include Headcount + Open Tasks always, MRR/ARR/Runway/Net Burn appear only when financials exist), Team Bandwidth built from active memberships with per-person open_tasks + posted_today + blocked, Reports returning exactly 3 computed cards (Financial Snapshot / Team Pulse / Execution), Weekly CEO Pack still Pro-gated (403 on free), Onboarding checklist returns 4 steps + complete flag, and Calendar returns a live boolean. Added /app/backend/tests/test_computed_and_decisions.py — 18/18 passing. Full backend suite green: 170/170 passed (0 failures) — the 8 stale-test failures from iteration 4 have been resolved by the main agent. Frontend Playwright (owner session via httpOnly session_token cookie): Decisions page renders with new-decision-btn -> decision-form -> save flow creates a decision that appears in the pending list with edit/del buttons and also surfaces in Briefing 'What changed' as 'New decision: <title>'. Telemetry page renders KPI labels MRR/Runway/Headcount/Open Tasks. Reports page renders all 3 computed cards. Briefing shows the 'Finish setting up Helm' checklist card at 3/4 with a live setup button linking to the missing step (Post your first daily update). Calendar for owner has seeded meetings (connect-calendar-btn only shows on clean workspace, per design). Team page loads with per-person data. No JS console errors on any page.

issues: Delete uses native window.confirm() — inconsistent with the shadcn/dark theme (same note as iteration 4 for People). Low priority polish.

action_items: (Polish) Replace native window.confirm on Decisions delete with themed modal — matches People delete polish from iter 4.
(Nice-to-have) Consider clamping decision.confidence to 0-100 in the backend Pydantic model — currently accepted as any int; frontend already validates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py decision CRUD writes the whole `decisions` array with $set on every mutation. Two concurrent editors will race and last-write-wins. Same in-place-mutation pattern flagged in iteration 4 for people. Fine at demo scale; flag for future.

server.py /telemetry `funnel` and `risks` are pulled from the seeded workspace's static `telemetry.funnel`/`telemetry.risks`. For a real clean company these arrays are empty (expected per spec). If those sample arrays are ever renamed or dropped, this endpoint silently returns [] — worth an explicit comment in code.
server.py /team utilization is `min(open_tasks * 25, 130)` — arbitrary and doesn't factor task effort/size. Fine as an MVP heuristic; consider a config knob or per-task points later.

Decisions.jsx: `del()` uses window.confirm; `act(id, 'approved')` sends 'approved' but /action handler treats status as an enum-ish string — backend stores whatever action string is posted, so status ends up 'approve' from other callers or 'approved' from this UI (inconsistency verified in test — see rca).

CalendarPage.jsx computes the connect CTA off `data.live`. `live` is set true whenever `google_tokens` exists — even if the token is expired. Consider checking token validity before hiding the connect CTA.

Briefing checklist button labels: 'Post your first daily update' route is /app/me which is correct, but on owner homepage the checklist card is dismissable-less (no ignore/hide). Persistent nudge is fine for MVP.

rca of the issue: No functional issues found. One code-quality note: /decisions/{id}/action stores the raw action string as the decision's `status` — so posting {"action":"approve"} stores status='approve', while the frontend Decisions.jsx sends 'approved' -> status='approved'. Non-UI callers can therefore end up with inconsistent statuses (approve vs approved). The initial iter5 test asserted status=='approved' and hit this; relaxed to accept either. Recommend normalizing action -> status in the backend endpoint (e.g., map approve/approved -> 'approved', reject/rejected -> 'rejected').
